svg.text: pad-ble v1 on the ESP32-P4: where everything goes
THE BOARD IS NOT ON THE BREADBOARD: it sits beside it and five jumpers reach header P6, whose own pin numbers label the terminals. Every wire is read out of the schematic.
the plug half of the cable
on the P4 board, beside the board
4 numbered jumpers, and 5 short wires to the rails
Every one of these is read out of the schematic. Red stubs go to the nearest + rail, blue stubs to the nearest - rail; they are not numbered because they are all the same instruction.
PAD1_D0, the green lead: J1 D0 to R1 col 26 row H
PAD1_D0, the green lead: R1 col 26 row H to U1 GPIO6
PAD_CLK, the blue lead: J1 CLK to U1 GPIO3
PAD_LATCH, the black lead: J1 OUT0 to U1 GPIO2
